race.comment: VESPASIAN (7) is ready to win after another minor placing, finishing second over 1700m at Geelong when he was always up in the leading division. Overdue for a win and looks tough to beat on recent figures. WHO I THINK I AM (11) is a five-start maiden who finished fourth after being in contention on the turn at her most recent appearance over 1900m at Newcastle. Freshened for this slightly sharper trip and expected to be in the finish. THE CELLIST (12) is going better than form looks, the latest settling last and turning there before running on late into fourth over 1590m at Wodonga. Fitter for two runs back and will be tough to stop on best. THINKIMACELEBRITY (6) better run last time out when second over 1590m at Wodonga, beaten one length. Include.
